verdict.rationale: Brex's APIs (transactions, budgets, expenses, users) support list/filter operations and the MCP server exposes account data to AI assistants, implying some batch querying capability, but there is no documented bulk-write endpoint (e.g., bulk expense approval, bulk card issuance, bulk transaction categorization) or explicit batch operation support in the API/MCP docs. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch write API endpoints, documented bulk operation support in MCP server, hands-on evidence of performing multi-item operations in one call.
